sections.title: Explanation
sections.content: Mennyi means 'how much' and is used to ask about price or the amount of something that isn't counted in individual units, like rice or water.

items.english: I'd like one kilo of rice.

sections.content: Mennyi a rizs? literally asks 'how much [is] the rice' — Hungarian drops 'is' here just like it drops the copula in other short third-person sentences.
